{{Top|leg}}
'''Hydraulic adjusters''' were part of the leg mechanism of an [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transport]]. The adjusters were located in the foot, attached to the vehicle's footpad.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
